title: Implement durable turn attempts, leases, and fencing
description:
Add the minimum durable ownership model required by the reliability stories.

Acceptance criteria:
- Stable turn_id and monotonically distinct attempt identity.
- Conditional claim and renewal with an expiry time.
- A fencing value is checked on every event append and action request.
- A duplicate worker can detect ownership without calling the model.
- Tenant identity is part of every key and condition.
- Unit and Behave scenarios prove concurrent claims and stale writes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Starting the ownership model: conditional claim, lease expiry, fence on chunk append. Behave covers duplicate delivery and stale writes. No EventBridge reaper in this slice (e42008).
